description: This file declares helper functions for configuring PUCCH, PRACH, and PUSCH resources in a 5G NR context, including calculations for PRB intervals, frequency start, resource counts, and time domain resource recomputation.

methods.name: find_largest_prb_interval_without_pucch
methods.description: Computes the largest PRB interval within a BWP that is free of PUCCH resources, assuming resources are on both ends of the BWP.

methods.name: compute_prach_frequency_start
methods.description: Calculates the starting frequency for PRACH to avoid collision with PUCCH guardbands, based on TS 38.331.

methods.name: compute_nof_sr_csi_pucch_res
methods.description: Determines the number of PUCCH resources used for SR and CSI, constrained by maximum grants per slot.

methods.name: compute_max_nof_pucch_symbols
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of PUCCH symbols based on SRS parameters.

methods.name: recompute_pusch_time_domain_resources
methods.description: Recomputes or adds PUSCH time-domain resources to enable scheduling in SRS slots.
